remaining_limits.detail: Lighter, Extra Light, Full City, our lightest and multi-tier ranges remain raw source text unless the page supplies an explicit supported category or local definition. No universal synonym mapping was introduced.
Roast marker percentages, bar counts and unlabeled image colors do not establish one of the seven tiers.
Contradictory independent current HTML, selected structured descriptions, product tags or explicit profiles remain reviewable conflicts instead of selecting an arbitrary value.
A compact list in a generic hero or prose container may lack evidence identifying it as this coffee flavor profile. Such text remains supplementary rather than being guessed from a flavor dictionary.
Literal sensory prose can include aroma, texture, finish or qualifiers that differ from a short canonical oracle list. Strict mismatches are not automatically treated as successful extraction.
Transport/structural/text budgets remain finite. Additional dynamically loaded text or pixels may require source review; this code does not introduce paid calls, OCR or unrestricted crawling.
Literal case/punctuation/conjunction/order equivalence may be classified separately during review, but the frozen oracle and strict scorer remain unchanged.
